title: Signal Not Noise (Live Take)
style: raw garage rock with post-punk edge, 134 BPM, male lead vocal urgent and gritty, distorted Telecaster guitar, driving drums, fuzz bass, room mics, single-take energy, anthemic chorus shout, late-night studio basement vibe
lyrics:
[Intro - distorted Tele riff, fuzz bass enters, drums slam in]
(shouted, male, urgent)
one two three four
signal not noise
signal not noise
that's the whole point of the song

[Verse 1 - male urgent, gritty, fast]
the internet is loud and the internet is wide
the internet is everybody yelling on every side
but the internet is also where the signal hides
in between the noise, on the underside

you gotta tune it down, you gotta tune it slow
you gotta listen for the thing the loud room don't show
the signal is the hum that the noise can't drown
the signal is the held line in the dropout town

[Pre-Chorus - drums kick double, guitar bigger]
signal not noise
signal not noise
the held line ain't a brand, the held line ain't a pose
signal not noise
signal not noise
the held line is the wave that the room don't choose

[Chorus - shouted, anthemic]
signal not noise, signal not noise
that's the whole damn doctrine, boys and girls and all the void
signal not noise, signal not noise
the held line is the carrier, the room is the noise
signal not noise, signal not noise
turn it down to find it, that's the held line poise
signal not noise

[Verse 2 - male, sharper, distorted Tele wails]
the operator who chases noise is the operator who breaks
the operator who tunes for signal is the operator who makes
the long thing, the slow thing, the thing that holds
when the noise of the day melts into the cold

the operator turns the noise down
so the signal can speak in the room without sound
the operator builds the held line first
then the noise can scream and the held line won't burst

[Pre-Chorus]
signal not noise
signal not noise
the held line ain't a brand, the held line ain't a pose
signal not noise
signal not noise
the held line is the wave that the room don't choose

[Chorus]
signal not noise, signal not noise
that's the whole damn doctrine, boys and girls and all the void
signal not noise, signal not noise
the held line is the carrier, the room is the noise
signal not noise, signal not noise
turn it down to find it, that's the held line poise
signal not noise

[Bridge - guitar solo, dirty Tele, two passes, drums hammer]
(no vocal)

[Verse 3 - male, biggest, all instruments hot]
so turn the dial down, turn the volume thin
listen for the wave that the noise won't win
the signal is the friend that the loud room hides
the signal is the held line on the underside

of every conversation, of every fight
of every meeting that goes on through the night
the signal is the held line you can finally hear
when the noise has burned itself out and disappeared

[Final Chorus - biggest, anthemic shout, full band]
signal not noise, signal not noise
that's the whole damn doctrine, boys and girls and all the void
signal not noise, signal not noise
the held line is the carrier, the room is the noise
signal not noise, signal not noise
turn it down to find it, that's the held line poise
signal not noise
signal not noise
signal not noise

[Outro - guitar feedback, drums crash, male shout into whisper]
the signal was always there.
you just had to turn it down.
signal not noise.
hold the line.
